item.title: Korankei Gorge: Central Japan's Greatest Autumn Foliage — Guide
item.description: Korankei is the most celebrated autumn foliage spot in central Japan, a river gorge near Toyota city where some 4,000 maple trees — descendants of those planted by a temple priest in the 1630s — blaze crimson and gold across the slopes of Mount Iimori each November. The scarlet Taigetsukyo bridge and the reflections doubling every colour in the slow Tomoe River provide the signature views, and throughout the month-long Korankei Momiji Festival the entire gorge is illuminated nightly until 21:00, when the tunnels of glowing maples take on an almost theatrical beauty.
